svg.title: POHL ANGEL — AI & Full-Stack Developer
svg.desc: POHL ANGEL banner. AI & Full-Stack Developer, ~/construct and momokoboi. Carbon grain, soft green portal and terminals, four foreground fingers around the G and thumb behind. Eyes removed. Detailed layers cached at banner resolution; wing and Matrix motion share a 12-update-per-second clock. Reduced motion stops animation. Native editable vector source retained separately.
